CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[FieldLookupValueByFieldTypeID] ( @fieldTypeID int ) RETURNS @lookupValues TABLE ( -- Add the column definitions for the TABLE variable here FieldTypeID int not null, LookupObjectType varchar(20) not null, LookupObjectID int not null, [Value] int not null, [Text] nvarchar(max) null ) AS Begin Declare @targetLookupType varchar(20); Declare @targetLookupObjectId int;
select @targetLookupType = LookupObjectType, @targetLookupObjectId = LookupObjectID from FieldType where ID = @fieldTypeID;
if (@targetLookupType = 'Artifact') Begin /* Artifacts with no parents and matching display value just show the display value */ Insert into @lookupValues SELECT T.ID as FieldTypeID, T.LookupObjectType, T.LookupObjectID, A.ObjectID as Value, A.DisplayValue as Text FROM FieldType T INNER JOIN AssetDetail A on T.LookupObjectID = A.TypeID and A.[Object] = 'Artifact' INNER JOIN AssetType ATT on (A.AssetTypeID = ATT.ID) WHERE not exists ( select 1 from intersecttype it inner join [predicate] p on it.predicateid = p.id and p.[type] = 3 and it.[subject] = 'ArtifactType' and it.[object] = 'ArtifactType' and it.objectid = A.TypeID) and coalesce(T.LookupEditFormat, T.LookupDisplayFormat) = ATT.DisplayFormat and T.ID = @fieldTypeID
UNION ALL
/* Artifacts with no parents and different display value just show the display value */ SELECT T.ID as FieldTypeID, T.LookupObjectType, T.LookupObjectID, A.ID as Value, utility.GetFormattedFieldLookupValue(T.Type, coalesce(T.LookupEditFormat, T.LookupDisplayFormat), T.LookupObjectType, T.LookupObjectID, A.ID) as Text FROM FieldType T INNER JOIN Artifact A ON T.LookupObjectID = A.ArtifactTypeID INNER JOIN AssetType ATT on (Att.[Object] = 'ArtifactType' and ATT.ObjectID = A.ArtifactTypeID) WHERE not exists ( select 1 from intersecttype it inner join [predicate] p on it.predicateid = p.id and p.[type] = 3 and it.[subject] = 'ArtifactType' and it.[object] = 'ArtifactType' and it.objectid = A.ArtifactTypeID) and coalesce(T.LookupEditFormat, T.LookupDisplayFormat) <> ATT.DisplayFormat and T.ID = @fieldTypeID
UNION ALL /* Artifacts with parents need to show the path which is slower */ SELECT T.ID as FieldTypeID, T.LookupObjectType, T.LookupObjectID, A.ID as Value, utility.GetFormattedFieldLookupValue(T.Type, coalesce(T.LookupEditFormat, T.LookupDisplayFormat), T.LookupObjectType, T.LookupObjectID, A.ID) as Text FROM FieldType T INNER JOIN Artifact A ON T.LookupObjectID = A.ArtifactTypeID WHERE exists ( select 1 from intersecttype it inner join [predicate] p on it.predicateid = p.id and p.[type] = 3 and it.[subject] = 'ArtifactType' and it.[object] = 'ArtifactType' and it.objectid = A.ArtifactTypeID) and T.ID = @fieldTypeID
END
IF (@targetLookupType = 'Resource') Begin Insert into @lookupValues SELECT T.ID as FieldTypeID, @targetLookupType as LookupObjectType, @targetLookupObjectId as LookupObjectID, R.ResourceID as Value, utility.GetFormattedFieldLookupValue(T.Type, coalesce(T.LookupEditFormat, T.LookupDisplayFormat), T.LookupObjectType, T.LookupObjectID, R.ResourceID) as Text FROM FieldType T INNER JOIN reporting.Global_Resource R on T.ID = @fieldTypeID End
IF (@targetLookupType = 'Lookup') Begin Insert into @lookupValues SELECT T.ID as FieldTypeID, T.LookupObjectType, T.LookupObjectID, L.ID as Value, utility.GetFormattedFieldLookupValue(T.Type, coalesce(T.LookupEditFormat, T.LookupDisplayFormat), T.LookupObjectType, T.LookupObjectID, L.ID) as Text FROM FieldType T INNER JOIN Lookup L ON T.LookupObjectID = L.LookupTypeID WHERE T.ID = @fieldTypeID End
IF (@targetLookupType = 'ReferenceItem') Begin Insert into @lookupValues SELECT T.ID as FieldTypeID, T.LookupObjectType, T.LookupObjectID, RI.ID as Value, utility.GetFormattedFieldLookupValue(T.Type, coalesce(T.LookupEditFormat, T.LookupDisplayFormat), T.LookupObjectType, T.LookupObjectID, RI.ID) as Text FROM FieldType T INNER JOIN ReferenceItem RI ON T.LookupObjectID = RI.ReferenceItemTypeID WHERE T.ID = @fieldTypeID
end
IF(@targetLookupType = 'ReferenceItemType') BEGIN Insert into @lookupValues SELECT T.ID as FieldTypeID, T.LookupObjectType, T.LookupObjectID, RIT.ID as Value, utility.GetFormattedFieldLookupValue(T.Type, coalesce(T.LookupEditFormat, T.LookupDisplayFormat), T.LookupObjectType, T.LookupObjectID, RIT.ID) as Text FROM FieldType T INNER JOIN ReferenceItemType RIT ON T.ID = @fieldTypeID END
IF(@targetLookupType = 'Taxonomy') BEGIN Insert into @lookupValues SELECT T.ID as FieldTypeID, T.LookupObjectType, T.LookupObjectID, TAX.ID as Value, utility.GetFormattedFieldLookupValue(T.Type, coalesce(T.LookupEditFormat, T.LookupDisplayFormat), T.LookupObjectType, T.LookupObjectID, TAX.ID) as Text FROM FieldType T INNER JOIN Taxonomy TAX ON T.LookupObjectID = TAX.TaxonomyTypeID WHERE T.ID = @fieldTypeID END
IF(@targetLookupType = 'TaxonomyType') BEGIN Insert into @lookupValues SELECT T.ID as FieldTypeID, T.LookupObjectType, T.LookupObjectID, TAXTYPE.ID as Value, utility.GetFormattedFieldLookupValue(T.Type, coalesce(T.LookupEditFormat, T.LookupDisplayFormat), T.LookupObjectType, T.LookupObjectID, TAXTYPE.ID) as Text FROM FieldType T INNER JOIN TaxonomyType TAXTYPE ON T.ID = @fieldTypeID END
RETURN END
